item.title: Spinach and Tortellini Salad
item.description: This spinach and tortellini salad recipe tosses cheese tortellini with spinach, Parmesan cheese, cherry tomatoes, black olives, and Italian dressing.

item.title: Southern Fried Cabbage
item.description: Fried cabbage with crispy bacon and onion - delicious! This recipe is quick and easy to make for a superb side dish to serve with your favorite roast.

item.title: Simple Steamed Artichokes Recipe
item.description: These simple steamed artichokes are cooked over water with garlic, bay leaf, and lemon juice for a light, healthy, and delicious vegetarian appetizer.

item.title: Sesame-Honey Mustard Vinaigrette
item.description: Traditional honey mustard meets rice vinegar and sesame oil in this creamy, tangy dressing that's a breeze to make.

item.title: Knedliky - Czech Dumpling with Sauerkraut (Zeli)
item.description: This knedliky-Czech dumpling with sauerkraut (zeli) recipe is formed into a loaf, wrapped in cheesecloth, boiled, then served with bacon and sauerkraut.

item.title: Irish Boxty
item.description: Boxty is a traditional Irish potato pancake made with grated and mashed potatoes; pan-fry until golden and crispy on the outside and fluffy inside.

item.title: Fava Beans in Tahini Sauce
item.description: Fava beans are cooked with onions and garlic in a thick tahini sauce. You can stuff this mixture into a pita, add a dollop of plain yogurt, and enjoy!

item.title: Easy Asparagus Casserole
item.description: This creamy asparagus casserole has layers of tender asparagus, sliced hard-boiled eggs, and crushed crackers topped with shredded Cheddar cheese.

item.title: 'Dressed' Cucumber
item.description: This simple cucumber salad recipe comes from Barbados.

item.title: Dirt Road Martini
item.description: Dolly Parton and Rachel Parton George share their unique twist on a classic martini in their cookbook "Good Lookin' Cookin'." In addition to olives, the sisters add in iced tea and pickled vegetables.

item.title: Cheesy Skillet Chickpeas
item.description: These cheesy skillet chickpeas are a great side dish with any meat or fish or taste great on their own with some crusty bread,

item.title: Cauliflower Steaks with Gremolata
item.description: These simple cauliflower steaks make a delicious side dish when served with gremolata.

item.title: Spanish-Style Swiss Chard with Raisins and Pine Nuts
item.description: A simple side dish with wilted Swiss chard stir-fried with pine nuts and raisins delivers a Spanish flair to your dinner table.

item.title: Charoset
item.description: This charoset recipe is easy to make with grated apples, walnuts, honey, and cinnamon for a sweet, fruity relish and a wonderful Passover treat.

item.title: Honey-Mustard Marinade
item.description: This easy honey-mustard marinade is made from common pantry items, has only a few ingredients, and is great for chicken pieces or pork chops.

item.title: Honey Mustard Broccoli
item.description: A fun twist on plain roasted broccoli, this version is coated with tangy honey mustard and works with any main dish.

item.title: Hot Honey Roasted Cauliflower
item.description: This hot honey roasted cauliflower, bold and flavorful, is an easy side dish to make, and takes only 3 ingredients.

item.title: Pickled White Asparagus, Cucumbers, and Peppers
item.description: These pickled white asparagus, cucumbers, and peppers are great on their own for pickle lovers, but can also be chopped and tossed with lettuce for a quick side salad to accompany steak.

item.title: Brussels Sprout Hash
item.description: Honey-flavored butter and cooking wine are the secrets to tasty sauteed Brussels sprouts made quickly.

item.title: Fiesta Onions
item.description: This is a great salad for onion lovers!

item.title: Easy Baked Zucchini Fries
item.description: Strips of zucchini coated with olive oil and bread crumbs are baked for a crispy appetizer or side dish everyone will love.

item.title: Instant Pot® Steamed Vegetables
item.description: Use your Instant Pot® and Chinese bamboo steamer baskets to steam any vegetables until crisp and tender.
